note: Lifted verbatim from the UNIT_RULES list inside scripts/import_g10_math_support.py, so the generic importer reproduces the 37 unit tags that script had baked into itself. Order matters: every matching rule contributes its tags, so the broad الفصل الأول / الفصل الثاني rules sit last and only add a semester tag on top of whatever unit already matched.

الدائرة|أوتار|مماسات|الزاوية المركزية|الزاوية المحيطية|الشكل الرباعي الدائري|الزاوية المماسية
